parse.title: Blast Furnace
parse.wikitext:
==Requirements==
* Started {{SCP|Quest}} [[The Giant Dwarf]] to gain access to [[Keldagrim]].
* {{NoCoins|2500|c}} per 10 minutes of use. {{SCP|Smithing|60|link=yes}}{{Boostable|no}} allows you to skip this fee.
** Equipping the [[ring of charos (a)]] will reduce the entrance fee to {{NoCoins|1250|c}}, if you go through [[Blast Furnace Foreman]]'s dialogue {{Chat option|1|3|2|3}}.
* On Blast Furnace [[World#Themed worlds|themed worlds]], {{NoCoins|72000|c}} per hour (1,200 coins per minute) must be deposited into the [[coffer (Blast Furnace)|coffer]] near the bank chest to pay the dwarven workers operating the blast furnace. The fee is time-based ({{NoCoins|12|c}} per [[RuneScape clock|tick]]). Coins in the coffer are only spent while logged in at the Blast Furnace basement on a Blast Furnace world. The unspent amount can be withdrawn at any time, even in non-Blast Furnace worlds.
* On non-Blast Furnace themed worlds the furnace must be operated manually, see below.
* [[Ice gloves]], [[smiths gloves (i)]], or a [[bucket of water]] are needed to cool down metal bars quickly, to avoid waiting for them to cool down with time.
